pre_tool_use.command: python -c "from researchos.runtime.hooks import validate_knowledge_access; import json, sys; r=validate_knowledge_access('${TOOL_NAME}', json.loads('${ARGUMENTS}')); sys.exit(0 if r['allowed'] else 1)"

post_tool_use.command: python -c "from researchos.runtime.hooks import validate_artifact_write; import sys; r=validate_artifact_write('${FILE_PATH}'); print(r.get('reason','')); sys.exit(0 if r['allowed'] else 1)"
